name: Democratic Party
description: Follow Democratic Party, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Dems hand GOP fresh midterm weapon by opposing widely used voter ID
changes.summary: Senate Democrats’ recent rejection of voter ID is giving Republicans fresh ammunition in the midterm fight, putting them on the opposite side of a practice that is common across the country and broadly popular with voters in both parties. Republicans have developed a cynical view of why Democrats won’t play ball with v.

changes.title: Latter-day Saints women turn away from scandal-plagued Republican candidate in Arizona
changes.summary: Arizona Republican candidate for Congress Mark Lamb has been accused of sexual misconduct while sheriff. His controversy is turning many voters away as Democrats see an opportunity in the red seat. (Image credit: Drew Angerer).

changes.title: Democrats Lead Governor Races Deep in Republican Territory, Polls Show
changes.summary: Democratic advantages in the races for governor in Texas, Iowa, Ohio and Alaska reflect deep unhappiness with President Trump and the economy. A Republican leads in Kansas.

changes.title: Some Democrats, Scarred by 2024, Take a Harder Line on Trans Athletes
changes.summary: Democrats competing in historically conservative territory in the midterms are more aggressively responding to Republican attacks casting them as extreme.

changes.title: Some Democrats Say Senate Race In South Carolina Is Winnable. Others, not so much.
changes.summary: Dr. Annie Andrews, a Democrat, is hoping to defeat Senator Darline Graham. Even some of her most ardent supporters sense that her bid is a long shot.

changes.title: Democrats May Have Found the Recipe for Flipping Red-State Senate Seats
changes.summary: Five new Times/Siena polls continue a run of strong results for Democrats in states that President Trump won easily in 2024.

changes.title: As Midterms Near, Justice Alito Says He Considers Each Year Whether to Retire
changes.summary: The justice, the second oldest on the court at 76, told CBS News that he decided against stepping down last term. He could face pressure should Democrats win the Senate in November.

changes.title: California voters to decide on controversial one-time tax on billionaires
changes.summary: California voters will decide whether the state will charge a one-time tax on billionaires. The idea that has split Democrats and labor unions.

changes.title: In Texas, Talarico’s Strength in Senate Polls Inspires a Democratic Dream
changes.summary: After a dry spell of more than three decades, Democrats are daring (yet again) to believe they can win one or more top-of-the-ballot races in a vast and stubbornly red state.

changes.title: Democrats want a blue wave. New Hampshire is Exhibit A for why that may not happen
changes.summary: Five weeks before Election Day, Democratic optimism is soaring. But glaring vulnerabilities threaten to undermine the unstoppable blue wave that Democrats believe is coming.
